decisions.reason: A low-cost plugin close to the core offer, listed on the website, with no evidence of failure, so dropping it would save little and would contradict its visible listing.
The ERP interface took the most development effort, builds on the established offer and fits the announced multichannel direction, so escalation of commitment strongly favours keeping it.

A price comparison tracking plugin that supports the firm's measurable-marketing promise, publicly listed and cheap to maintain, with any weak results still attributable to its short time on the market.
One of three overlapping price comparison plugins, so it carries some consolidation risk, but low maintenance cost and its public listing make keeping it more likely.
Another overlapping price comparison plugin that may be consolidated, but nothing indicates its results are failing beyond temporary causes, so it is likely kept.
A net price reporting plugin that complements the net price display plugin, close to the core offer and visibly marketed, so the firm is likely to persist with it.
